metadata.methods_description: Data were collected using EEG recording while participants performed a visual word recognition task. Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room at a viewing distance of 152 cm from a 24-inch LCD monitor. Stimuli consisted of four-letter words and pseudowords presented in white font on a black background, with flanker words separated by 3.28 degrees of visual angle. Each trial began with a purple fixation cross (1000 ms), followed by a white fixation cross (500 ms), stimulus presentation (150 ms), and a blank screen until participant response via game controller.
